settings.title: Settings
settings.credentialConsumptionDescription: Controls whether presenting a credential uses up one of its batch copies
settings.zkCircuitHostingDescription: Mirror/fallback hosting services for ZK-proof circuit artifacts, one URL per line. Tried in order; the first that responds is used.
settings.credentialDetailsDescription: Whether tapping a credential opens the detail screen (raw credential, claims, disclosures).
settings.diagnosticMessagesDescription: Show the raw backend step token alongside the friendly progress label during a flow.
settings.photoIdOnboardingDescription: Show a "Get your PhotoID" shortcut on Home when this tenant offers identity-verified PhotoID issuance
settings.transactionDataDescription: Allow payment and login confirmations that show you the transaction before you approve it. Applies to requests started after you change it; with the WMP transport, to the next connection (sign out and in again). Needs a key other than a software key, and biometric verification.

wscd.title: WSCA Developer
wscd.destroyConfirmMessage: This permanently destroys the enrolled key and any keys derived from it, locally and on the backend if the active plugin supports remote revocation. This cannot be undone.
wscd.r2psNoPublicKeyWarning: No server public key configured - R2PS registration will fail until one is provided.
wscd.defaultMappingDescription: Adds a WalletConfig.defaultWscdMapping entry - see the Mapping card above the tabs for the full, unfiltered table across ALL plugins. Host-app/dev config, not persisted across restarts.
wscd.preferredWscdDescription: Always use %1$@, even for credentials that don't require it. Applies to every issuer unless a per-issuer override below takes precedence.
wscd.mappingDescription: Which (issuer, credential type) pairs always use a specific WSCD plugin. Discover candidates from registry.siros.org, then switch the ones you want on - each is assigned to the cheapest plugin whose tier satisfies it (e.g. iso_18045_basic → softkey, not fido2). "Saved" rows are real per-issuer preferences (also set from the security-key prompt's "This issuer" option); "Dev default" rows are session-only entries added in a plugin tab's Developer section below.
wscd.tofuDescription: Ambiguous-choice outcomes remembered per (issuer, credential type), so you're only asked once. Forget a choice to be asked again next time.

wscdChoice.title: Choose a Security Key
wscdChoice.description: This credential (%1$@ from %2$@) requires a hardware-backed key. Choose which security key to use:

fido2.pinDescription: Enter the PIN for your FIDO2 security key.

idv.stepFaceScanDescription: Scan your face to show you are a real, live human
idv.stepDocumentScanDescription: Scan the photo page of your passport or ID card
idv.stepNfcDescription: Place your phone on your document to read the NFC chip
idv.prereqDocument: Have your passport or ID card ready
idv.whyFaceScanDescription: A 3D face scan verifies you are a real, live person. Your biometric data is encrypted during capture and processed only for identity verification. It is not stored after the session.
idv.consentText: I consent to biometric processing for identity verification.

errors.unavailable: Identity verification is not available on this device.
errors.liveness_failed: We could not confirm that a live person was in front of the camera. Please try again in good light, facing the camera.
errors.verification_failed: Your scan could not be accepted. Please try again in good light, or use another identity document.
errors.nfc_not_requested: This document cannot be verified by its chip. Please use an e-passport or an ID card whose chip can be read.
errors.nfc_device_not_capable: This device could not read the chip. Make sure NFC is turned on and try again.
errors.nfc_skipped: Reading the chip in your document is required. Please try again and hold your document against the top of the phone when asked.
errors.nfc_chip_read_failed: The chip in your document could not be read. Please try again and hold the document still against the top of the phone.
errors.nfc_not_authenticated: The chip in your document could not be verified, so no credential was issued.
errors.chip_untrusted: The chip in your document could not be confirmed as issued by a recognised authority, so no credential was issued.
errors.document_expired: This document has expired, so no credential was issued. Please use a valid identity document.
errors.session_expired: The verification took too long or was already used. Please start again.
errors.issuance_failed: Your identity was verified, but the credential could not be issued. Please try again later.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side, so no credential was issued. Please try again later.
errors.locked_out: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.request_aborted: The verification was interrupted. Please try again.
errors.initialization_failed: Identity verification could not be started. Please try again later.
errors.unknown_internal_error: Something went wrong during the scan. Please try again.
errors.no_session_result: The scan ended without a result. Please try again.

home.photoIdOnboardingDescription: Verify your identity to add a government-grade PhotoID credential

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: The wallet installations registered to this account. Suspending one blocks it until it is reactivated; removing one is permanent.
devices.empty: No wallet instances registered yet. One is registered the first time this installation obtains a wallet instance attestation.
devices.suspendSelfWarning: Suspending this device signs it out until it is reactivated from another device or by your provider.
devices.removeConfirmMessage: %1$@ will be removed permanently and can never be reactivated. Removing the last device deactivates the wallet and erases its data.
devices.deactivateDescription: Removes every device and erases this wallet's data on the server. A new enrollment is required afterwards.
devices.deactivateConfirmMessage: This cannot be undone. Type %1$@ to confirm.
devices.deactivateComplete: Wallet deactivated: %1$d device(s) removed and the server-side data erased.
devices.deactivateIncomplete: Wallet deactivated: %1$d device(s) removed, but the server could not finish erasing its data. Your provider must complete it.

walletBlocked.suspendedMessage: Reactivate it from another one of your devices, or contact your wallet provider. Your credentials are untouched.
walletBlocked.revokedMessage: Its access to this wallet was revoked. Your other devices are unaffected. Enroll again to use this one.
walletBlocked.deactivatedMessage: Every device was removed and the wallet's data was erased on the server. Enroll again to start over.

transactionConsent.title: Confirm Transaction
transactionConsent.unsignedWarningBody: This request is not signed, so its origin could not be verified. Only continue if you trust the party that asked you.
transactionConsent.unsignedAcknowledge: I understand and want to continue

reasons.unsupportedFormat: This kind of credential cannot confirm transactions.
reasons.notScaAttestation: This credential is not a payment confirmation credential.
reasons.unsupportedType: This transaction type is not supported by the credential.
reasons.schemaViolation: The transaction details were not valid.
reasons.metadataUnavailable: The information needed to show the transaction was not available.
reasons.unsupportedHashAlgorithm: The requested security algorithm is not supported.
reasons.insufficientAuthenticationFactors: Two different ways of confirming it is you could not be established.
reasons.noConsentHandler: This app cannot show the transaction.
reasons.signingFailed: Your confirmation did not lead to a presentation.
